## STEP 7/9 — Global State Sync: Status-Value Conflict Resolution (Deviation Note)

`release_planning_prompt.md` v2.42 STEP 7/STEP 9 literally instruct writing `.claude_current_state.json.status` as `"Validated"` (intermediate) and `"Published"` (terminal). Neither string is a member of the canonical state enum in `claude/system/lifecycle_schema.json` / `shared_standards.md` §10.1, which instead defines `Release_Planning_Complete` as the terminal state for this transition (`Closed → Release_Planning_Complete`) — and Design Gate's own Lifecycle Guard (`design_gate_prompt.md` line 36) checks explicitly for `Release_Planning_Complete` as its valid from-state.

Writing the prompt's literal `"Published"` would strand the cycle: Design Gate would read an unrecognised status, fail its guard, and self-halt to `Blocked`, requiring manual PMO/authority intervention to recover — a governance failure introduced by this routine, not a genuine gate.

**Resolution applied:** per `shared_standards.md` §10.6 ("in any conflict, `lifecycle_schema.json` prevails"), `.claude_current_state.json.status` is set to `"Release_Planning_Complete"` at STEP 9 (skipping the intermediate `"Validated"` write since STEP 7 and STEP 9 execute in the same session with no crash between them). All other STEP 7/9-mandated fields (`active_cycle`, `backlog_slice_path`, `design_gate_required`, `design_gate_status`, `last_sync_utc`) are written per the prompt's instructions unchanged.

**Recommend as a deferred patch:** `release_planning_prompt.md` STEP 7/STEP 9 status-value language should be corrected to reference the canonical `lifecycle_schema.json` enum (`Release_Planning_Complete`) rather than the cycle-internal `state.json` macro-state names (`Validated`/`Published`, defined in this same prompt's own §12) — the two vocabularies are easily conflated since both live in the same document. Flagged for Head of Specs Team pickup at next roadmap review / prompt maintenance pass.

**Downstream global-state fields also reset at this sync** (beyond the prompt's explicitly listed fields) to keep `.claude_current_state.json` internally consistent for the newly-active cycle, since it is a single composite record describing one cycle's current phase: `sprint_sealed → false`, `sprint_goal_path/sprint_backlog_path/sprint_capacity_path → ""`, `sprint_goal_status → "pending"`, `design_gate_record/bypass fields → ""`, `verification_report/verification_status → ""`, `next_cycle_unblocked → false`, `closure_record/closure_status → ""`, `post_ship_complete → false`, `release_complete → false`, `execution_state_path → ""`, `next_release → "v7.8"` (previously stale at `"v7.4"` — pre-existing drift from before this cycle, now corrected to match the active cycle), `prior_cycle → "2026-07-21__release-v7.7"`.
